5. Deck Description:
Fen is fun with cards that build, and build off of, the reserve. This deck takes some of the early set evergreen Fen cards and adds in cards from the other sets to support the reserve build and play. The goal is to be fun and show off interactions from multiple sets. No card costs more than 3 mana, so you have to set up to let the characters punch above their weight class.

Some key aspects:

Build Your Reserve - Anansi is included as the classic Fen card that builds off your reserve. But this setup gets even better with Lyra Contortionist and Tech Lab Unit to build to a larger max reserve. Lyra Signet gives you the opportunity to turn any character into Anansi with its boost option. 

Manage & Boost Your Reserve - Bliss Bassist, Doppelganger, and Soul Encounter let you keep boosts or boost characters in reserve, letting them come out stronger. Ouroboros Inkcaster lets you get key cards back into your hand. This is good for a noon Fen Resupply you'd rather have in hand.

Boost Your Characters - Soul Encounter, Lyra Signet, Winter Outfits, and Eat Me Energy Bars help boost stats out in your expeditions.

Defense - You may not have some of the biggest characters, so remove some of your opponent's with Cloth Cocoon, Requiem, Tanuki, and Sea Nymph. A Capella Training and Lyra Signet also help get rid of characters early by giving fleeting. Early A Capella Training, even day 1 if you are 2nd player can help disrupt your opponent early. Sap Duende is there to grab some late game boosts from an opponent's big character - especially fun to snag back boosts after someone drops The Hunger on your perfectly curated reserve.

5. Deck Description:
Aggressive version of Zhen with many low cost characters and ascend effects.

Core startegy:
win the game fast with many characters in ascended expeditions. Get more draw than your opponent and put pressure on both expeditions.

Key synergies and how the decks works:
- cable-car station and Zhen ability to draw
- Origamium and characters able to ascend their expedition
- cable-car station and spike stats : the station can be used to escape the regions where characters have 0 stat (gargoyle, frog king, sandman)
- removal spells : rapidly progress on expeditions while slowing down the setup of your opponent. These Spells can also be useful to draw thanks to zhen power.
- Sagitta + soar + origamium to boost the big bird and reduce its cost.
- rallying call + license withdrawal can discard strong characters
- Axiom signet triggers both landmarks of the deck, and has a versatile second effect
- Sandman is useful to finish the game fast

This deck works as a starter deck because the cards are simple and are also working very well with Zhen. The numerous small synergies are satisfying and can be learned progressively.
